title: mri_nu_correct.mni
description: Wrapper for nu_correct, used for correcting intensity non-uniformity (bias fields).

input_volume.description: Input volume. Can be any format accepted by mri_convert.
input_volume.title: Input Volume

output_volume.description: Output volume. Can be any format accepted by mri_convert.
output_volume.title: Output Volume

iterations.description: Number of iterations to run nu_correct. Default is 4.
iterations.title: Number of Iterations

proto_iterations.description: Passes as argument of the -iterations flag of nu_correct.
proto_iterations.title: Prototype Iterations

mask_volume.description: Brainmask volume. Can be any format accepted by mri_convert.
mask_volume.title: Mask Volume

stop_threshold.description: Threshold for stopping iteration. Suggest values between 0.01 to 0.0001.
stop_threshold.title: Stop Threshold

ants_n4_replace_zeros.description: Replace 0s with small random numbers then remove after nu correction.
ants_n4_replace_zeros.title: ANTS N4 Replace Zeros Flag

cm_flag.description: For use with data that is higher than 1mm resolution.
cm_flag.title: CM Flag
